name: craft3d
description: The craft3d engine behind the /3d-model and /wireframe Claude Code commands: library, viewer, examples and the headless check tool.

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium && node tools/install.mjs
scripts.setup:cad: python3 -m venv .ocp && .ocp/bin/pip install --quiet cadquery-ocp numpy && .ocp/bin/python -c "import OCP, numpy; print('CAD tools ready: .ocp/bin/python tools/step2mesh.py')"
